Bettina, I can't set up the weekly digest yet. The scheduler rejected my request with a credentials error (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled and I haven't posted anything.

What I checked:
- #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so a digest drawing on both won't show anything new to anyone.
- The first run would be Monday 19 October at 08:00 America/Chicago, and then every Monday after that.

Once the Gateway scheduler is authorized, I'll set it up. It will post in #coastal-team with items from the previous week in both channels, plus open customer items. It will leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices), which go to Anselm, June and the account owner rather than into a channel. If you'd like a different time or channel, tell me before it's created.
